Package one.x1f.sip.foundation.core.declarative.connector

Interface ConnectorProcessor

All Superinterfaces:
ConnectorExtension, Consumer<org.apache.camel.model.RouteDefinition>, org.apache.camel.Processor
All Known Subinterfaces:
ModelMapper<S,T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseMappingRouteTransformer, MethodBasedConnectorProcessor, RequestMappingRouteTransformer, ResponseMappingRouteTransformer
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ConnectorProcessor extends ConnectorExtension, org.apache.camel.Processor
Interface that marks extensions that can be placed within the integration flow of a connector.

Connector processors are a more specific type of ConnectorExtensions that are geared to work with the payload on each integration call.
